alex.description: Young teenage boy with spiky brown hair, large black rectangular glasses, expressive brown eyes, friendly smile, orange and black hoodie, dark pants and orange-white sneakers.
important_constraints: Keep the same hairstyle, glasses, facial proportions, clothing colors and body proportions.
Maintain consistent appearance throughout every frame.

jack.description: Small playful Jack Russell Terrier puppy with white fur, warm brown patches around the eyes and ears, floppy brown ears, large expressive eyes, black nose and fluffy tail.
important_constraints: Keep the same fur pattern, brown facial markings, ear shape, eye proportions and body proportions.
Maintain consistent appearance throughout every frame.

story.summary: Alex and Jack spend a joyful afternoon playing together on a grassy playground.

timeline.action: Alex walks onto the grassy playground while Jack runs excitedly beside him.
timeline.animation: natural child walking motion and energetic puppy running
timeline.camera: wide establishing shot slowly moving forward

timeline.action: Alex gently kicks a colorful ball across the grass. Jack immediately notices it and excitedly chases after it.
timeline.animation: Alex swings his leg naturally and kicks the ball; Jack accelerates after the ball with playful puppy movement.
timeline.camera: medium tracking shot following the ball and Jack

timeline.action: Jack catches up to the ball, playfully grabs it and runs back toward Alex.
timeline.animation: ears and tail bounce naturally while running; puppy looks happy and excited.

timeline.action: Jack drops the ball near Alex. Alex laughs, bends down and gently pets Jack.
timeline.animation: Alex crouches naturally and scratches Jack behind the ears; Jack wags his tail enthusiastically.
timeline.camera: medium close-up with gentle cinematic camera movement

timeline.action: Alex throws the ball again. Jack jumps excitedly and runs after it while Alex runs behind him laughing.
timeline.animation: energetic running, playful jumping and exaggerated but believable cartoon motion.
timeline.camera: wide cinematic tracking shot ending with both characters running across the playground

alex.movement: natural teenage body mechanics with slightly exaggerated cartoon animation
alex.facial_animation: frequent smiling, laughing and excited expressions

jack.movement: energetic puppy movement with realistic weight and exaggerated cartoon charm
jack.facial_animation: happy eyes, open-mouth smile and excited expressions

camera.composition: keep both characters clearly visible whenever they interact

continuity_rules: Alex must remain visually identical throughout the entire video.
Jack must remain visually identical throughout the entire video.
Do not change character age or body proportions.
Do not introduce additional main characters.
The same playground must remain visually consistent.
The ball must remain the same color and design.
